items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued September 27 at 2:47AM PDT until September 28 at 3:00AM PDT by NWS San Francisco CA
items.description:
* WHAT...West winds 10 to 20 kt with gusts up to 30 kt expected.

* WHERE...Monterey Bay.

* WHEN...From 9 AM this morning to 3 AM PDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
